messages.subject: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat arguments
parts:
Hi - I am using MaxQtoMSstatsFormat to convert maxquant files.  I was trying to test some of the different argument settings, for example setting removeMpeptides=FALSE, instead of the default TRUE, but the output file does not change when I toggle this argument.  I have confirmed that I have peptides with M in them in the original file, and they are all removed after running MaxQtoMSstatsFormat.   I am quite new to R, so it is highly likely I am making a silly mistake.

Thanks!

-Danielle

Sincerely,
- Meena

messages.subject: Re: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat arguments
parts:
I am having an issue with the parameter of "useUniquePeptide" in the MaxQtoMSstatsFormat.  I have used the following input, as illustrated in the user manual:

MY RESULTS:
> quant <- MaxQtoMSstatsFormat(evidence=infile, annotation=annot, proteinGroups=proteinGroups, useUniquePeptide = TRUE)
** + Contaminant, + Reverse, + Only.identified.by.site, proteins are removed.
** Peptide and charge, that have 1 or 2 measurements across runs, are removed.
>

USER MANUAL RESULTS:
quant <- MaxQtoMSstatsFormat(evidence=infile, annotation=annot, proteinGroups=proteinGroups) 
## + Contaminant, + Reverse, + Only.identified.by.site, proteins are removed. 
## Peptides, that are used in more than one proteins, are removed. 
## Peptide and charge, that have 1 or 2 measurements across runs, are removed.

The useUniquePeptide feature is not working, as illustrated by the missing output line in MY RESULTS, and as evidenced by proteins containing the ";" value in the generated quant table.
